note: Table-stakes derived from the direct cluster scanned 2026-09-10: open-webui, LibreChat, Onyx, AnythingLLM, Suna, OpenHands, Open Notebook, Khoj, SurfSense. A capability is table-stakes only if effectively all of them ship it.

capabilities.test: a documented single compose command brings the stack up
install pulls published container images instead of compiling from source
tagged releases exist with per-version changelog sections
the repo is publicly cloneable by a stranger
hosted documentation beyond in-repo markdown
swap between several LLM providers at runtime
runs against a local/OpenAI-compatible endpoint
answers can be grounded in live web search
upload own documents into a persistent, queryable corpus
connect external MCP servers to extend the action space
history persists and a session can be resumed
first-party browser UI, not CLI-only
the instance is not open to anyone who reaches the port
agent code/shell runs isolated from the host
claims are tied to retrieved sources
export results to at least one portable format
multiple accounts with roles/SSO
OpenTelemetry or Prometheus instrumentation
a maintained Helm chart or k8s manifests
a published score on a recognized benchmark
